newsitem.title: FRANCE: Milosevic arrives for Paris talks with Izetbegovic.
newsitem.headline: Milosevic arrives for Paris talks with Izetbegovic.

text.p: Serbian President Slobodan Milosevic arrived in Paris on Wednesday ahead of talks in the French capital with Bosnian Moslem President Alija Izetbegovic, witnesses said. He made no statement.
The two leaders are scheduled to meet at 0800 GMT on Thursday after which they will each hold separate talks with French President Jacques Chirac.
Their talks are to focus on building peace after Bosnia's elections and normalising relations between the two countries, French officials said.
The three presidents will lunch together on Thursday joined by Carl Bildt, Swedish chief international civilian representative in Bosnia, and French Foreign Minister Herve de Charette.
